light_exo_suit.name: Light Exo-Suit
light_exo_suit.description: A lightweight powered exoskeleton that enhances protection without sacrificing mobility.

heavy_combat_armor.name: Heavy Combat Armor
heavy_combat_armor.description: Military-grade plated armor with integrated shields. Built like a tank.

stealth_suit.name: Stealth Suit
stealth_suit.description: Nano-fiber weave with adaptive cloaking technology. Nearly invisible in shadows.

service_droid.name: Service Droid
service_droid.description: A helpful maintenance droid that assists with gathering and repairs.

benefit.description: +1 to all gathering rolls when equipped

combat_droid.name: Combat Droid
combat_droid.description: A battle-ready droid armed with integrated weapons systems.

repair_bot.name: Repair Bot
repair_bot.description: An autonomous repair unit that keeps your gear in top condition.

benefit.description: Can repair other crafted items (consumes materials)

hover_board.name: Hover Board
hover_board.description: A sleek personal transport with anti-grav thrusters. Fast and agile.

speeder_bike.name: Speeder Bike
speeder_bike.description: A high-speed hoverbike capable of incredible acceleration.

benefit.description: +3 to movement/chase rolls, -40% cooldowns when equipped

jump_pack.name: Jump Pack
jump_pack.description: Powerful back-mounted thrusters for vertical mobility and short flight.

benefit.description: +2 to escape/dodge rolls, -20% cooldowns when equipped

long_range_comm.name: Long-Range Communicator
long_range_comm.description: Advanced communication array with enhanced scanning capabilities.

benefit.description: +3 to scanning and threat detection, can communicate across zones

shield_generator.name: Personal Shield Generator
shield_generator.description: Portable energy shield that absorbs incoming damage.

benefit.description: Absorbs 10 damage before breaking, recharges after combat

hacking_tool.name: Multi-Tool Hacking Device
hacking_tool.description: A sophisticated device for bypassing electronic security systems.

benefit.description: +3 to hacking rolls, can unlock secure areas and data

portable_forge.name: Portable Fabrication Unit
portable_forge.description: A compact 3D printer and assembly station. Craft anywhere.

benefit.description: Can craft items in any location (still requires materials)

scanner_visor.name: Tactical Scanner Visor
scanner_visor.description: HUD visor with threat assessment and environment analysis.

medical_drone.name: Medical Assistance Drone
medical_drone.description: An automated medical drone with emergency treatment protocols.

benefit.description: Heals 15 HP once per combat encounter
